name: Roborock Saros 20 Flow
description: Roborock's just-launched Saros flagship, named for its SpiraFlow 2.0 pressurized roller-mop wash system. Pairs a retracting LiDAR turret with an AdaptiLift chassis that climbs double-layer thresholds up to 3.46" despite an ultra-slim body. Launched in the US on September 14, 2026.

pricing.summary: Launch price $1,499.99 through roughly September 20, 2026, reverting to a $1,699.99 MSRP afterward. Launched in the US on September 14, 2026, following an IFA 2026 announcement; a Canada launch is planned for October 2026.

editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware
editorial.body: The "Flow" name refers to SpiraFlow 2.0, a pressurized self-cleaning roller-mop system that runs 16 water outlets continuously across the roller while mopping at up to 15N of pressure and 240 RPM; an edge-adaptive roller extends 44mm into corners, and the mop auto-lifts 15mm on carpet. Navigation combines a retractable, elevated LiDAR unit (RetractSense) — which tucks away for tight clearances — with structured-light and RGB-camera-based reactive AI recognizing 300+ obstacle types, plus LED lighting for low-light navigation. The AdaptiLift Traverse 3.0 chassis is the successor to the leg-lift design on the earlier Saros 10R, letting an ultra-slim 8.98cm-tall body climb double-layer thresholds up to 8.8cm (3.46") — normally out of reach for a body this low-profile. The RockDock handles auto-empty, automatic water and detergent refill, dirty-water draining, mop washing at 212°F, and hot-air drying at 145°F. The Roborock app adds no-go zone suggestions, pet-friendly detection, a built-in "Hello, Rocky" voice assistant, and Matter/Alexa/Siri/Google Home compatibility; robotindex could not confirm explicit multi-floor mapping support, exact dustbin/water-tank capacities, or a published noise-level (dB) figure from the sources checked.

sourcing: Specs sourced from Roborock's own US product pages (us.roborock.com/products/roborock-saros-20-flow), Android Authority's launch coverage, VacuumWars' launch article, and GSMDome, as of September 2026. This model launched just days before this page was written — noise level (dB), exact runtime in minutes, and exact dustbin/water-tank capacities are not published by Roborock and were not found in press coverage checked. robotindex does not sell this product.
